newsitem.title: USA: Court approves First Merchants, Ugly Duckling deal.
newsitem.headline: Court approves First Merchants, Ugly Duckling deal.

text.p: First Merchants Acceptance Corp said Thursday that a debtor-in-possession financing agreement from Ugly Duckling Corp was approved today by a Delaware Federal Court where its Chapter 11 bankrutpcy case is pending.
The interim approval allows First Merchants to use a $5 million line of credit. A final hearing on the full $10 million line of credit from Ugly Duckling will be scheduled for next month.
First Merchants filed for protection under Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code on July 11.
First Merchants finances used-car loans for consumers whose access to traditional sources of credit is limited.
